_comment: Source of truth for every string drawn into an App Store screenshot. Edit this file only; the other locales are produced by ../translate-copy.mjs (DeepL) except fr-FR, which is hand-written. Keys are scene ids; `shared` is drawn on every scene.

shared.placeholder: Enter URL, text, or drop a file…

headline: Drop it.
It knows what it is.
subtitle: Link, contact, Wi-Fi, event —
the format is worked out on its own.

headline: Any code.
Yours again.
subtitle: Point the camera at a code, or pick
a picture. Restyle it, keep what it says.

Not settings you read.

Dead centre.

code still scans. Caption underneath.
